annotations.title: Arrange the Shop the post grid

description: Move tiles by hand: post_ids (from shop_posts_list) go first in this order, after any pinned tiles; the rest follow, newest first. A post that goes out later lands on top until you arrange again. [] puts the whole grid back to newest first. Pin or hide a tile with shop_post_update.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
